sample_unit: patients screened (19,828 before and 22,962 after NaIA-RD implementation)

links.outcome: GP screening sensitivity and agreement with AI in deployed workflow, before versus after AI
links.effect: NaIA-RD influenced screening criteria of 3/4 GPs, increasing their sensitivity. Agreement with GPs was 94.6% or more for non-referral proposals but 23.4% to 86.6% for referral proposals.
links.quote: NaIA-RD influenced the screening criteria of 3/4 GPs, increasing their sensitivity.

screen.reason: Evaluates a real-world before-and-after implementation of a custom AI diagnostic assistance tool (NaIA-RD) into general practitioners' screening workflow for diabetic retinopathy.
